reference_text: Gradient descent updates model parameters in the direction opposite to the estimated loss gradient. This local update aims to reduce the training objective, although convergence depends on the objective and the optimization settings. A suitable learning rate can support stable progress, whereas an excessively large rate may cause oscillation or divergence. In stochastic training, gradients computed from minibatches introduce noise, so a single update need not reduce the full training loss.
